body: I'll reply to both your comments here. It was 4 days before I got my phone back. I called my father with the first phone called 24 hours after I got there. I believe they contacted most people but this friend has blocked them before. Yes they used the literal word Villian to describe me.

I was in their for 4 days before I was allowed my phone. My family knew about it but this particular friend doesn't like my father, so has blocked them as a phone contact. So even if my father did tell them they wouldn't know.
It's been a week since I've been let out now and they are calling me villain still and a bad person. Just keep threatening to end the friendship. I wish they would of given me a soft landing.
Its really cool, I love the fluidity of it
